levels.description_en: General-purpose ways of working with AI: clarifying ideas, brainstorming and planning before writing code.
levels.description_pt: Jeitos gerais de trabalhar com IA: esclarecer ideias, fazer brainstorming e planejar antes de escrever código.

levels.description_en: Day-to-day software engineering: frameworks, up-to-date documentation, performance and UI quality.
levels.description_pt: Engenharia de software do dia a dia: frameworks, documentação atualizada, performance e qualidade de interface.

levels.description_en: Testing, product discovery, requirements, specs and tickets.
levels.description_pt: Testes, discovery de produto, requisitos, specs e tickets.

items.name: web-design-guidelines
items.description_en: Create, improve, or audit web interfaces and reusable UI components for accessibility, responsive design, UX, Lighthouse quality, and SEO. Use for Vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript, Node-based web tooling, Angular, React, or ASP.NET Core MVC/Razor Pages; do not use for backend-only tasks.
items.description_pt: Cria, melhora ou audita interfaces web com foco em acessibilidade (WCAG), responsividade, UX, Lighthouse e SEO. Funciona com HTML/CSS/JS puro, Angular, React e ASP.NET Core MVC/Razor.
items.author: dev-cristhian

items.name: web-pending-change-auditor
items.description_en: Read-only multi-stack code-review agent that audits pending Vanilla, Node, Angular, React, and ASP.NET MVC/Razor web changes in Git or TFVC/TFS against project guidelines.
items.description_pt: Agent de code review somente leitura: audita as mudanças pendentes (Git ou TFVC/TFS) de projetos web em HTML/CSS/JS, Node, Angular, React e ASP.NET MVC/Razor, usando a skill web-design-guidelines como referência.
items.author: dev-cristhian

items.name: brainstorming
items.description_en: Turns rough ideas into a validated design through collaborative, one-question-at-a-time dialogue before implementation.
items.description_pt: Transforma uma ideia ainda crua em um design validado, com um diálogo de uma pergunta por vez antes da implementação.
items.author: obra

items.name: grill-me
items.description_en: Relentlessly interviews you about a plan or design until every branch of the decision tree is resolved.
items.description_pt: Faz uma bateria de perguntas sobre o seu plano ou design até resolver cada decisão em aberto, antes de qualquer código.
items.author: mattpocock

items.name: writing-plans
items.description_en: Writes detailed, step-by-step implementation plans that an agent (or a teammate) can execute with little context.
items.description_pt: Escreve planos de implementação detalhados, passo a passo, que um agent (ou uma pessoa do time) consegue executar com pouco contexto.
items.author: obra

items.name: analyzing-dotnet-performance
items.description_en: Scans .NET code for about 50 performance anti-patterns (async, memory, strings, LINQ, regex, serialization, I/O) with tiered severity.
items.description_pt: Procura cerca de 50 anti-patterns de performance em código .NET (async, memória, strings, LINQ, regex, serialização, I/O) e classifica por gravidade.
items.author: dotnet

items.name: angular-developer
items.description_en: Official Angular team skill for writing modern Angular code (signals, standalone components, current APIs).
items.description_pt: Skill oficial do time do Angular para escrever Angular moderno (signals, standalone components, APIs atuais).
items.author: angular

items.name: dotnet-webapi
items.description_en: Guides creating and changing ASP.NET Core Web API endpoints with correct HTTP semantics, OpenAPI metadata and error handling.
items.description_pt: Orienta a criação e a alteração de endpoints em ASP.NET Core Web API com semântica HTTP correta, metadados OpenAPI e tratamento de erros.
items.author: dotnet

items.name: frontend-design
items.description_en: Guides distinctive, intentional visual design when building or reshaping a UI: aesthetic direction, typography and non-templated choices.
items.description_pt: Orienta um design visual marcante e intencional ao criar ou repaginar uma interface: direção estética, tipografia e escolhas que fogem do visual de template.
items.author: anthropics

items.name: optimizing-ef-core-queries
items.description_en: Reviews and optimizes Entity Framework Core data access: slow or memory-heavy queries, excessive round-trips and hidden SaveChanges.
items.description_pt: Revisa e otimiza o acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core: queries lentas ou pesadas, idas e voltas demais ao banco e SaveChanges escondidos.
items.author: dotnet

items.name: Angular CLI MCP Server
items.description_en: Official Angular CLI MCP server: best practices, documentation search, examples and project-aware tools for Angular workspaces.
items.description_pt: MCP oficial da Angular CLI: boas práticas, busca na documentação, exemplos e ferramentas que entendem o seu workspace Angular.
items.author: angular

install.command: claude mcp add --scope user angular-cli -- npx -y @angular/cli mcp

items.name: Context7 MCP Server
items.description_en: Injects up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples into the prompt. Works without an API key; set CONTEXT7_API_KEY for higher limits.
items.description_pt: Coloca no prompt a documentação atualizada (e da versão certa) das bibliotecas que você usa. Funciona sem API key; defina CONTEXT7_API_KEY para limites maiores.
items.author: upstash

install.command: claude mcp add --scope user --transport http context7 https://mcp.context7.com/mcp

items.name: Microsoft Learn MCP Server
items.description_en: Remote MCP server that searches and fetches official, up-to-date Microsoft Learn documentation and code samples. No authentication required.
items.description_pt: MCP remoto que busca a documentação oficial e atualizada do Microsoft Learn (.NET, Azure etc.) e exemplos de código. Não exige login.
items.author: microsoft

install.command: claude mcp add --scope user --transport http microsoft-learn https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp

items.name: discovery-process
items.description_en: Guides an end-to-end product discovery process, from problem framing to validated opportunities.
items.description_pt: Conduz um processo completo de discovery de produto, do enquadramento do problema até oportunidades validadas.
items.author: deanpeters

items.name: playwright-generate-test
items.description_en: Generates Playwright tests from a scenario by exploring the app with the Playwright MCP first.
items.description_pt: Gera testes Playwright a partir de um cenário, explorando a aplicação com o Playwright MCP antes de escrever o teste.
items.author: github

items.name: prd-development
items.description_en: Helps write a structured Product Requirements Document (PRD).
items.description_pt: Ajuda a escrever um PRD (Product Requirements Document) estruturado.
items.author: deanpeters

items.name: to-spec
items.description_en: Turns the current conversation into a spec and publishes it to the project issue tracker, with no extra interview.
items.description_pt: Transforma a conversa atual em uma spec e publica no issue tracker do projeto, sem nova rodada de perguntas.
items.author: mattpocock

items.name: to-tickets
items.description_en: Breaks a plan, spec or conversation into tracer-bullet tickets with their blocking dependencies, published to your tracker.
items.description_pt: Quebra um plano, uma spec ou a conversa em tickets (tracer bullets) com as dependências entre eles e publica no seu tracker.
items.author: mattpocock

items.name: user-story
items.description_en: Writes user stories in Mike Cohn format with Gherkin acceptance criteria.
items.description_pt: Escreve user stories no formato de Mike Cohn, com critérios de aceite em Gherkin.
items.author: deanpeters

items.name: user-story-mapping
items.description_en: Builds a user story map to organize the backlog around the user journey and plan releases.
items.description_pt: Monta um user story map para organizar o backlog pela jornada do usuário e planejar entregas.
items.author: deanpeters

items.name: Playwright MCP
items.description_en: Lets the agent drive a real browser through Playwright using accessibility snapshots instead of screenshots.
items.description_pt: Permite que o agent controle um navegador de verdade via Playwright, usando a árvore de acessibilidade em vez de screenshots.
items.author: microsoft

install.command: claude mcp add --scope user playwright -- npx -y @playwright/mcp@latest
